analysis: Explicit post-hoc full-cohort audit; no algorithm or target changes
unit: 37 requests from 37 distinct source image IDs and source image SHA256s, confirmed by replay

bootstrap.pairing: one common resample index matrix for each full-cohort endpoint/contrast

binary_guardrail_test.name: Exact two-sided McNemar
binary_guardrail_test.implementation: twice smaller Binomial(n_discordant, .5) tail, capped at 1
binary_guardrail_test.timing: added after fixed audit as sparse-outcome check; no change to option-count comparison family

metric_definitions.review_option_count: Semantic matches when any exist; otherwise all exported instances.
metric_definitions.semantic_correct_any_match: At least one normalized semantic match reaches target IoU threshold.
metric_definitions.geometry_correct_any_exposed: At least one option actually exposed by the rule reaches target IoU threshold, including fallback options with mismatched labels.
metric_definitions.geometry_correct_any_exported: At least one of all exported instances reaches target IoU threshold regardless of query exposure or label.
metric_definitions.unique_and_correct: Exactly one semantic match that reaches target IoU threshold.
metric_definitions.wrong_unique: Exactly one semantic match below target IoU threshold.

limitations: No new independent cases; results were known before this post-hoc uncertainty audit.
Option counts are an objective interface proxy, not measured human time or workload.
Equal observed correctness totals do not establish equivalence or noninferiority.
Auxiliary subsets are GT-conditioned post-hoc mechanism diagnostics, not full-cohort or causal evidence.
Only option count contrasts have four-comparison Bonferroni intervals; all guardrail intervals are descriptive pointwise 95%.
